cohort: 586 women with a singleton gestation and a prior cesarean delivery in maternity department at Salmaniya medical complex, Manama, Kingdom of Bahrain during the period between June 2017 to July 2018
finding: Diabetes mellitus and systemic hypertension were associated with a higher likelihood of ELCS, previous vaginal delivery was associated with higher likelihood of TOLAC, and risk of bleeding was higher in the ELCS group, while other maternal and fetal outcomes were similar between groups.
